name: job.opsmd.fit
description: James Loehr Managing Director search: qualify one posting for a multi-unit / regional operations leader (rental-fleet, dealership groups, hospitality, facilities, logistics, PE-backed multi-site service businesses). Band per playbook 6b verified in jobs/comp-bands.md: TC >= $275K floor, base $185K+ target (lane-dependent), walk-away base $170K only with TC restore. National, relocation accepted. Routes to skip / apply / warm-intro-first.

comp_band.instructions: Total compensation this posting most plausibly pays, using the posted range and any bonus language. Base, bonus, OTE and equity are separate quantities; never substitute one for another. If no number is posted, infer from title, company size and multi-unit scope; unknown pay is never a pass.
criteria: Base clearly below $150K and no bonus structure that could plausibly restore total comp to $275K
Base $150K-$175K with a bonus-heavy structure plausibly restoring total comp to $275K+ (rental/mobility pattern: $150-175K base plus large target bonus), or unposted with a single-unit manager title
Base $175K-$225K, or unposted with a Managing Director / GM / multi-unit director title at a multi-site operator
Base $225K or more stated or strongly implied, or total comp clearly $300K or more

role_shape.instructions: Which shape best describes the job as written

criteria.multi_site_ops_md: Managing Director, GM, Regional VP or Director over multiple sites or units in a service operations business (rental/fleet, dealership, hospitality, facilities, logistics)
criteria.pe_portfolio_operating: Operating MD / GM / turnaround leader inside a PE-backed multi-site company
criteria.single_site_or_ic: One site only, or an individual contributor seat
criteria.functional_head_non_ops: Head of a non-operations function (finance, HR, IT, marketing, legal)

hard_disqualifier.instructions: The posting requires something the candidate does not have: an active security clearance, a specific professional license (CDL, CPA, PE), 10+ years managing software engineering teams, clinical credentials, or a named vendor certification as a must-have

seniority_match.instructions: The seniority is Managing Director, GM, Regional VP, Senior Director or Director of multi-site operations. Single-unit manager-and-below or pure IC is not a match

ops_evidence_fits.instructions: A candidate whose proof is multi-unit operations leadership (airport with 150 employees and 7 managers, district and regional scope, EBITDA goal beats, market-share gains, fleet and revenue accountability) would be a credible finalist for this role

rules.reason: quota seat, not the target lane
below walk-away with no total-comp path to $275K
seniority unclear; human reads the JD
in band -- warm-intro-first, do not cold-apply first
